title: CanMath
text:
CanMath is a Canadian Math Contest not from the Canadian Mathematical Society or CEMC Waterloo. This contest consists of 2 rounds, "The School Rounds" and "The Provincial Finals".


The School Round is a 40 minute round with 2 parts: an Individual Sprint round with 20 minutes for 20 questions and the Team Round with 20 minutes to solve 10 more challenging problems.

The Provincial Finals (Usually hosted at the University of Toronto) consists of 4 parts:

The Individual Sprint: 20 minute test with 20 problems.

The Team Round: With your team of 4, you’ll have 20 minutes to solve 10 more challenging problems.

The Individual Target Round: A more strategic, deep-thinking challenge. You’ll work through 10 problems presented in sets of two, with 10 minutes per set.

The Countdown Round: The top-scoring individuals advance to a head-to-head, tournament-style showdown. Competitors face off in pairs, answering one question at a time with one minute per question. Each match is a best-of-five match.


CanMath's first ever contest was hosted at Leading Aces Academy and not the University of Toronto.
